Book 2 teaching cohort, small version (simulated)

Source: R/data.R
growdat2_mini.Rd

A random 3,000-child subset of the full Book 2 cohort generated by wgh_simulate(30000, preset = "wgh_like", seed = 2026, style = "book2"). Column names follow Book 2 (schoolyear, bmiz). The full cohort is available with wgh_download(). growdat2_mini_truth holds the true child-level parameters (size, timing, intensity, phenotype, APHV, PHV).

Usage

growdat2_mini

growdat2_mini_truth

Format

Data frames. See wgh_simulate() for the columns.

An object of class data.frame with 3000 rows and 14 columns.

Examples

head(growdat2_mini)
#>       pid    sex  site        dob schoolyear   examdate    age height weight
#> 1 C000007   Male Site2 2001-09-24       2019 2019-10-05 18.029  176.0  101.7

#> 3 C000030 Female Site1 2003-11-24       2019 2019-11-20 15.989  158.8   65.5
#> 4 C000044   Male Site1 2014-10-24       2018 2018-11-05  4.033  105.6   20.0
#> 5 C000044   Male Site1 2014-10-24       2019 2019-11-28  5.095  112.8   23.4
